headline: The Fed Held.
Two Officials
Wanted a
Hike.
slides.subtitle:
10-2 vote keeps rates at 3.75% to 4.00%.
Inflation 'remains elevated.'

slides.title: What Just Happened?
slides.big: The Fed held rates at 3.75% to 4.00%.
slides.body: On Oct 28, the vote was 10-2. Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack preferred a quarter-point hike. The statement says inflation 'remains elevated.'

slides.title: Let's Look at the Numbers

slides.source: Source: BLS, CPI release of Oct 14, 2026.

slides.title: Why Should You Care?
slides.body: The Fed paused after its September hike, but the door to another is open. Markets priced about an 83% chance of a hike in December, per CME FedWatch.

items: Oil and gasoline prices feeding inflation.
